plugins.name: ai-cto
plugins.description: Fractional CTO advisor skills for non-technical product builders. Four skills covering the founder workflow end-to-end: first-build-scope (idea stage), feature-decision (feature stage), tech-evaluation (technology stage), architecture-review (architecture stage). Each loads named decision frameworks on demand via frameworks/INDEX.md and is grounded in the persona at cto-persona.md. The idea and feature skills chain after a brainstorming session via a handoff intake.
